deals.summary: Legion M Film Fund - 1099, based in Los Angeles, CA, is raising up to $1.8M by selling Membership Interests at $10.00/share on DealMaker. The company reported no revenue for its most recent fiscal year. Reported cash ($0) is below its annual loss ($8K), so this raise materially affects its runway.
flags: Pre-revenue: no sales reported in the most recent fiscal year.
Cash on hand covers less than half the most recent annual loss.
Issuer pays 8.5% of the amount raised plus setup/monthly fees to DealMaker.
